gaps: Not an AI-specific standard: it addresses ethical concerns in system design generally, and its application to AI systems is not prescribed by the text.

ai_provisions: Model process for eliciting ethical values from stakeholders and tracing them through an operational concept, value propositions, ethical requirements and risk-based design; a general systems-engineering process used in the IEEE 7000 family of AI-ethics standards.
relevance.excluded_scope: General systems-engineering standard, not an AI-specific instrument; voluntary and not law.
relevance.reason: IEEE 7000-2021 establishes a model process for addressing ethical concerns during system design. It is not AI-specific, but it is the central standard in the IEEE 7000 family applied to AI ethics and is therefore recorded in the technical-standards layer at metadata level.

rights.note: The standard is available free of charge through the IEEE GET Program and by subscription; it is not open-licensed. This corpus stores metadata and links only.
